decision: NX-032 run sheet 1.6 / phase B (dispatcher 2026-10-14): the service principals the stage Compose file needs beyond service-grants.v1.json, each with only the authority its code calls (evidence per grant in purpose: file and line), registered with service-grants.v1.json through the trusted configuration (scripts/deploy/stage_secrets.py register). Effect Actions (ADR-020 §3: never in the service grants manifest) only for effect_roles. One credential per principal: the credential files of one principal hold the same token. Not here: per-object READ of plan reevaluation Role Runs (RoleDefinition, ConsumerRoleLink, PlanStep, RoleExecutionCeiling, RoleAssignmentScope, catalog) is granted with the Role assembly of a tenant (phase C); those credentials are authenticated only when a plan launches. manifest_version 2 (NX-032 A1 design §4.4 / T6, dispatcher 2026-10-15): the two setup tools run once per tenant with their own service principals: business_owner (business_setup.py --owner-credential-file, then nexloop-relay-enroll --owner-credential-file as the EffectControl owner; its executor is effect_executor, the principal the action worker runs as, so the EffectControl it creates names that executor) and catalog_maintainer (catalog_setup.py --maintainer-credential-file; its delivery Source is relay_source, whose catalog READ comes from relay_source_read_rule). Their credential files live under setup/ and are added to a generated tree by `stage_secrets.py setup-credentials` before register; no Compose service mounts them. manifest_version 3 (G-ROLE, dispatcher 2026-10-15): role_assembler (nexloop_eios.role_assembly --assembler-credential-file) creates a consumer's standing Goal and PlanStep and its Role objects (ceiling, definition, assignment scope, link) through the published Actions; it requests ontology.roles.manage, which 0057/0081 require in the caller credential for the role Actions (service_grants requested_scopes). Its credential file is below setup/ like the other setup tools. manifest_version 4 (G-ROLE-READ, dispatcher 2026-10-17 option A): the per-object READ of plan reevaluation Role Runs is not granted per object (that would change role_source's credential scopes and need a rotation); role_source_read_rules names role_source, and 0211 derives in SQL, at each read, READ on exactly the objects of a current, active plan whose PlanStep lists role_source as a submitter (fixed properties only). register compiles the rule through 0050 like source_message_read_rules. manifest_version 5 (NX-054 P3, dispatcher 2026-10-25): the relation backfill CLI (scripts/deploy/relation_backfill.py --service-credential-file) runs as relation_backfiller (service-grants v20); its credential file is below setup/ like the other one-off tools; no Compose service mounts it.

principals.purpose: The effect executor: the action worker and webchat delivery run as it, and the relay, reply guarantor and plan reevaluator bind effect contexts to it (EffectControl.executor_principal, 0041/0042/0051).
The relay Context Source: issues message Runs with source proofs and binds their Context (catalog READ derived by relay_source_read_rule 0142, Message READ by its message_read_rule 0077).
Creates the Goal, PlanStep and MessageAssignment of a routed message and binds its effect context (message relay and reply fallback).
The Source of plan reevaluation Role Runs: issues the Run and binds the Role Context.
Binds the effect context of a plan reevaluation Role Run (planner differs from the Source and the control owner, 0179).
Accepts the Run activation event of a plan reevaluation Role Run into the operations queue.
The domain worker: one bounded page of final Artifact orphan maintenance per run (0018).

The owner of a tenant's business setup (business_setup.py): creates the Consumer and its EffectControl, configures the control for the effect executor and registers the human Consumer owner. Then enrolls the consumer with the relay (nexloop-relay-enroll). Used once per consumer by the operator, never by a running service.

The maintainer of a tenant's service catalog (catalog_setup.py): creates the ServiceOffering and the ConsumerServiceOffering that names relay_source as its delivery Source. Used once per consumer by the operator, never by a running service.

Assembles a consumer's Role (role_assembly.py): the standing Goal and PlanStep of its Role Runs, the execution ceiling, the RoleDefinition, the assignment scope and the ConsumerRoleLink. Used once per consumer by the operator, never by a running service.

source_message_read_rules.purpose: Message READ of the relay Source for the message Run Context (0077 derivation); conversation_id also covers the Message's own Conversation (0102 conversation_read_basis), which the Context's evidence reads (10/16: without it every pack's evidence was required_source_unreadable).

role_source_read_rules.purpose: READ of the plan reevaluation Role Run objects (RoleRunLauncher.issue/activate: plan_reevaluation.py 211-237, role_policies, role_activation, Context v6) derived by 0211 from current active plans whose PlanStep names role_source; no per-object grant, no new scope.
